theorems.name: Submission.lpf_tde_measurable_chart_differential
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (Φ : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : ℕ → Set (Eucl n)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), (∀ j, IsOpen (Ω j)) → (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ j)) → (∀ j, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω j, ∀ w' ∈ Ω j, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ j w - Φ j w'‖) → ∃ L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q), StronglyMeasurable L ∧ (∀ x, x ∉ (⋃ j, Φ j '' Ω j) → L x = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ (⋃ j, Φ j '' Ω j), ∃ j, ∃ w ∈ Ω j, Φ j w = x ∧ (∀ s : Eucl n, L x (fderiv ℝ (Φ j) w s) = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ j) w s) ∧ ∀ v : Eucl P, ∃ s : Eucl n, ‖fderiv ℝ (Φ j) w s‖ ≤ ‖v‖ ∧ L x v = fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ j) w s
